first_transaction_reveal.scope: Full actual AppMain/Lambda journals with all UI and behaviors. Baseline is original optimized AppMain; display_gate corrects deferred sidebar readiness; candidate also reveals the ready root synchronously in its first layer transaction instead of another main-queue turn. Same core and fixture, no probes/testability/injection.
first_transaction_reveal.control: separate immutable production binaries; same core and source base; randomized paired rounds; no CPU counters, injected library, Instruments or loader diagnostics

node-behavior-fast-path.scope: Throwaway exploration: full AppMain/Lambda journals/native UI. Nodes with no tree behavior, context menu, retained-pane state or theme contribution bypass those four inactive wrapper views. Surface geometry, accessibility, appearance events, enabled behaviors, navigation and toolbar are retained. No probes or testability.
node-behavior-fast-path.control: separate immutable production binaries; same core and source base; randomized paired rounds; no CPU counters, injected library, Instruments or loader diagnostics

plain-layout-kinds.scope: Throwaway exploration: full AppMain/Lambda journals/native UI. Plain stack, overlay and virtual-list containers use the existing layout-only surface path, preserving specified padding/sizing and falling back for decorations, constraints, margins and special styles. All UI and behavior retained. No probes or testability.
plain-layout-kinds.control: separate immutable production binaries; same core and source base; randomized paired rounds; no CPU counters, injected library, Instruments or loader diagnostics

button-construction-control.scope: Diagnostic omission: ordinary LUIButtonView replaced with bare SwiftUI Button/Text plus explicit sizing; six initial buttons lose rich labels, styles, menus and additional interactions. Actual AppMain/Lambda journal titles, navigation and surrounding surface/layout retained. This incomplete UI cannot be a product fix. No probes or testability.
button-construction-control.control: separate immutable production binaries; same core and source base; randomized paired rounds; no CPU counters, injected library, Instruments or loader diagnostics

height-measurement-control.scope: Diagnostic only: disable first-section minimum-height padding and its row-height tracking. Keep the complete real Lambda journal and chrome, using the corrected displayed-frame sidebar gate in BOTH binaries. This removes row-height state writes, unlike the prior measured-padding candidate. Missing short-day minimum-height behavior makes this ineligible as a product fix. No probes, testability or injected library.
height-measurement-control.control: separate immutable production binaries; same core and source base; randomized paired rounds; no CPU counters, injected library, Instruments or loader diagnostics

drawer-closed-shadow.scope: Complete AppMain/Lambda journals with first-transaction root reveal and displayed-frame sidebar gate in both binaries. Candidate makes the main-pane shadow clear only while the drawer progress is zero; keeps modifiers, native UI, all interactions and open-drawer shadow. No testability/probes/injection.
drawer-closed-shadow.control: separate immutable production binaries; same core and source base; randomized paired rounds; no CPU counters, injected library, Instruments or loader diagnostics

drawer-closed-material.scope: Complete AppMain/Lambda journals with first-transaction root reveal and displayed-frame sidebar gate in both binaries. Candidate makes the full-window main-pane backdrop material clear only while compact drawer progress is zero; retains active/open and pinned material, modifiers, content identity, native UI, all interactions and shadow. No testability/probes/injection.
drawer-closed-material.control: separate immutable production binaries; same core and source base; randomized paired rounds; no CPU counters, injected library, Instruments or loader diagnostics
